A Milli Futbol Takımı, UEFA Uluslar A Ligi 1. Grup'taki 5. maçında İzmir'de Belçika ile karşı karşıya geldi. Gürsel Aksel Stadı'nda oynanan mücadeleyi konuk ekip Belçika 2-1 kazandı.
A Milli Takım 'ın golü 20. dakikada Arda Güler'den gelirken Belçika'nın gollerini ise 27. dakikada Kevin De Bruyne ve 30. dakikada Charles De Ketelaere kaydetti.
Türkiye , Kocaeli'de Fransa'ya 1-0, Bursa'da İtalya'ya 4-1, deplasmanda Belçika'ya 3-0 ve Bologna'da İtalya'ya 3-1 kaybetti. Beşinci mücadelesinde İzmir'de Belçika'yı konuk eden milliler bu maçtan da mağlubiyetle ayrıldı.
Milliler, grup mücadelesini 15 Kasım'da deplasmanda oynayacağı Fransa karşılaşmasıyla tamamlayacak.
Gürsel Aksel Stadı'nda oynanan karşılaşmanın 20. dakikasında sahneye Arda Güler çıktı.
Ceza sahası yayının birkaç metre gerisinden, yaklaşık 30 metreden kazanılan serbest vuruşta topun başına geçen genç yıldız, sol ayağıyla harika bir vuruş yaptı. Barajı aşan top, kalecinin müdahalesine fırsat vermeden sol köşeden doksana gitti. Arda Güler'in bu muhteşem golüyle A Milli Takımımızı, Belçika karşısında 1-0 öne geçirdi.
⚽️ Arda Güler'in harika frikik golüyle Belçika karşısında 1-0 öne geçiyoruz! 🇹🇷🔥 pic.twitter.com/gKo4TM8XnK
Ozan Kabak, Belçika maçının 32. dakikasında gördüğü sarı kart nedeniyle cezalı duruma düştü.
Milli savunmacı, cezası sebebiyle ay-yıldızlı ekibin Fransa ile oynayacağı karşılaşmada görev yapamayacak.
Milli takıma uzun bir aradan sonra yeniden davet edilen Enes Ünal, 726 gün sonra A Milli Takım formasıyla sahaya çıktı.
Yaşadığı sakatlıkların ardından bu sezon LaLiga ekibi Getafe'de iyi bir sezon geçiren Enes, Sergen Yalçın'ın forvette görev verdiği isim oldu.
Enes, son olarak A Milli Takım'ın UEFA Uluslar Ligi'nde 16 Kasım 2024'te Galler ile oynadığı maçta forma giymişti.
Sergen Yalçın, Belçika karşısında sağ bekte Oğuz Aydın'a görev verdi.
Yalçın, Zeki Çelik'in tam hazır olmaması nedeniyle sağ bek tercihini Oğuz Aydın'dan yana kullandı. Zeki Çelik ise yedekler arasında yer aldı.
20. dakikada A Milli Futbol Takımı öne geçti. Ceza sahası yayının gerisinden Arda Güler'in kullandığı serbest vuruşta barajı geçen top sol üst köşeden ağlarla buluştu: 1-0.
26. dakikada Belçika eşitliği sağladı. Doku'nun sol kanattan getirip ceza sahası içerisine gönderdiği topla altıpas gerisinde buluşan De Bruyne, meşin yuvarlağı filelere gönderdi: 1-1.
30. dakikada Belçika öne geçti. Sağ kanatta topla buluşan De Cuyper pasını ceza sahası içindeki Moreira'ya aktardı. Bu futbolcunun vuruşunda top kaleci Uğurcan Çakır'dan döndü. De Cuyper, önünde kalan topu bu kez altıpas üzerindeki De Ketelaere'ye aktardı. De Ketelaere, meşin yuvarlağı ağlarla buluşturdu: 1-2.
Karşılaşmanın ilk yarısı, Belçika'nın 2-1 üstünlüğüyle sona erdi.
59. dakikada sol kanattan getirdiği topla ceza sahasına giren De Ketelaere, altıpas üzerinde defans oyuncularının arasında vuruşunu yaptı, kaleci Uğurcan Çakır meşin yuvarlağı kornere çeldi.
60. dakikada Türkiye gole yaklaştı. Hızlı atakta topla ilerleyen Arda Güler, meşin yuvarlağı ceza sahası solundaki Barış Alper Yılmaz'a aktardı. Barış Alper Yılmaz'ın şutunda kaleci Lammens meşin yuvarlağı kontrol etti.
82. dakikada Zeki Çelik, sağ kanattan getirdiği topu ceza sahası içerisindeki Deniz Gül'e aktardı. Deniz Gül'ün sağ çaprazdan şutunda kaleci Lammens meşin yuvarlağı çeldi.
90+2. dakikada ceza sahası içerisindeki Yunus Akgün, meşin yuvarlağı sağ çaprazdaki Hakan Çalhanoğlu'na aktardı. Hakan Çalhanoğlu'nun şutunu kaleci Lammens uzaklaştırdı.

Çin casusu olmakla suçlanan bir kişi ve üst düzey bir Nvidia çalışanıyla evlilik dışı ilişkisi ortaya çıkan CEO Jensen Huang koltuğunu kaybetti.
Yapay zeka sektörünün en önemli şirketi Nvidia'yı sarsan skandalda CEO Jensen Huang'ın geleceğine dair tartışmalarda son karar verildi.
Huang'ın görevine devam edip etmeyeceği merak edilirken toplanan şirketin Yönetim Kurulu, Huang ile yolları ayırdıklarını bildirdi.
Karara ilişkin açıklamada, Huang'ın CEO'luk pozisyonuna ek olarak Yönetim Kurulu'ndaki koltuğunu da kaybettiği bildirildi.
Şirketin Finans Müdürü Colette Kress'in geçici olarak CEO'luk pozisyonunu üstleneceği, bu sürede mevcut rolünü de sürdürmeye devam edeceği kaydedildi. Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, kalıcı yeni CEO'nun belirlenmesi için hem şirket içinden hem de dışarıdan adaylarla görüşmelere başlanacağını da bildirdi.
Geçtiğimiz günlerde Huang'ın hem " Çinli casus " olarak değerlendirilen bir kişiyle, hem de kendisine bağlı olarak çalışan üst düzey bir Nvidia görevlisiyle evlilik dışı ilişkisi ortaya çıkmıştı.
Nvidia'da liderlik değişikliğinin, önde gelen çip üreticisi için belirsiz bir dönemin kapısını arayabileceği değerlendiriliyor.
Dünyanın en değerli halka açık şirketleri arasında yer alan Nvidia, ABD'de yapay zeka çip pazarının yüzde 90'ını kontrol ediyor.
63 yaşındaki Huang, 1993 yılında Nvidia'nın kurucuları arasında yer aldı ve CEO olarak şirketin tüm faaliyetlerini yönetiyordu. Aynı zamanda Nvidia'nın yüzde 3,56'sına sahip olan Huang, şirketin en büyük bireysel hissedarı konumunda bulunuyor.
Bu arada casus skandalının odağındaki Singapur merkezli şirket Megaspeed, ABD makamları ile soruşturmada iş birliği yapacaklarını açıkladı. Şirket hakkında Singapur'da da bir soruşturma başlatıldı.
Nvidia'nın en büyük müşterilerinden biri olan Megaspeed'in Haziran 2024'ten bu yana 4,8 milyar dolar değerinde çip satın aldığı belirtiliyor.
ABD'li yetkililere göre, Nvidia CEO'su ile ilişkisi bulunan Megaspeed yöneticisi Alice Huang Çin adına casusluk yapıyordu, Washington'un Pekin'e satışını kısıtladığı yapay zeka çiplerinin bu ülkeye temininde de rol oynadı.
Casus soruşturmasının basına yansımasının ardından Nvidia hisseleri geçen ayki zirve seviyeye göre 1,5 trilyon dolardan fazla eridi.

DHA'nın aktardığı habere göre, yeni yönetmelik ile diyaliz merkezlerinin cihaz kapasitesine ilişkin üst sınır 60 cihazdan 80 cihaza çıkarıldı. Merkezlerin birleşmesi halinde de toplam kapasite 80 cihaz ile sınırlandırıldı. Ayrıca vakıf üniversitelerinin diyaliz merkezi ve ünitesi açabilmesine imkân sağlandı. Bu düzenleme ile diyaliz hizmetlerinin planlanması ve merkez kapasitesinin mevcut ihtiyaçlar doğrultusunda daha etkin şekilde yapılandırılması amaçlandı.
Diyaliz raporlarında periton diyalizinin uygulanmama kriterlerinin belirtilmesi zorunlu hâle getirildi. Bu düzenlemeyle klinik açıdan uygun hastalarda periton diyalizinin öncelikli olarak değerlendirilmesi ve hastaların tedavi seçeneklerinin kapsamlı biçimde ele alınması sağlandı.
Diyaliz hastalarının farklı illerde bulundukları dönemlerde hizmete erişimlerini kolaylaştırmak amacıyla tatil diyalizi dönemi genişletildi. Daha önce Haziran-Ekim döneminde uygulanan tatil diyalizi dönemi, yeni düzenleme ile Mayıs-Kasım sonu olarak belirlendi.
Yeni yönetmelik ile ev hemodiyalizine ilişkin mevcut uygulamanın temel esasları korunurken, hasta takip ve hizmet sunum süreçlerine yönelik düzenlemeler netleştirildi. Bu kapsamda aylık muayene ve reçete düzenlenmesinde nefroloji uzmanı önceliği korundu. Hastaların aylık zorunlu diyaliz muayenelerini, tedavi gördükleri diyaliz merkezi dışında kamu veya özel sağlık kuruluşlarında yaptırabilmelerine; düzenlenen diyaliz reçetesini tedavi aldıkları merkeze sunarak tedavilerini bu reçete doğrultusunda sürdürebilmelerine imkân sağlandı.
Diyaliz hizmetlerinin denetiminde uygulanan müeyyidelere idari para cezası da eklendi. Böylece mevzuata uyumun artırılması ve denetim süreçlerinin daha etkin yürütülmesine yönelik düzenleme yapıldı.
Yeni yönetmelik ile hastaların muayene ve tedavi süreçlerine erişimi kolaylaştırılırken diyaliz hizmetlerinin sunumu, merkezlerin kapasitesi ve denetim süreçlerine ilişkin esaslar güncellendi. Yapılan düzenlemelerle diyaliz hizmetlerinin daha erişilebilir, etkin ve sürdürülebilir bir yapıda yürütülmesine yönelik önemli değişiklikler hayata geçirildi.

İsrail'de hükümet kurma süreci ve devam eden ateşkese rağmen ordu Gazze'ye yönelik saldırılarını sürdürüyor. Han Yunus'ta bir hastane bombalandı, altı kişi yaşamını yitirdi.
İsrail'de geçen ayki seçimlerin ardından yeni bir hükümet kurma süreci devam ederken Gazze 'ye yönelik saldırılar da sürüyor.
Ordu, bugün erken saatlerde Gazze'nin güneyindeki Nasır Hastanesi'ni bombaladı. Olayda bir genel cerrah dahil altı kişi hayatını kaybetti, ameliyat sonrası hastaların bakımı için kullanılan bölüm ve bazı katların enkaza döndüğü bildirildi.
En az 28 kişinin de yaralandığı saldırıyı ordu, Hamas militanlarını hedef aldıkları iddiasıyla gerekçelendirdi ancak bu savunmasını destekleyecek herhangi bir kanıt sunmadı.
Haber ajansı AP'ye konuşan, aynı hastanede görevli İngiliz cerrah Goher Rahbour, öldürülen meslektaşı ile saldırıdan sadece birkaç saat önce bir ameliyat gerçekleştirdiklerini anlattı.
Han Yunus kentindeki Nasır Hastanesi, sağlık altyapısının büyük ölçüde tahrip edildiği Gazze'de hâlâ hizmet verebilen az sayıdaki tesisten biri.
İsrail ordusu 2023'te savaşın başlamasından bu yana, Hamas'ın hastaneleri komuta merkezi olarak kullandığını öne sürerek Gazze genelinde çok sayıda sağlık tesisine baskın düzenledi, tıbbi ekipman ve malzemeleri imha etti, yüzlerce sağlık çalışanını öldürdü veya gözaltına aldı.
Uluslararası hukuk, silahlı çatışmalar sırasında hastaneler ve sağlık çalışanlarına yönelik saldırıları yasaklıyor.
İsrail ordusu daha önce de Nasır Hastanesi'ne saldırmıştı. 2025'te hastane kompleksindeki yerel gazetecileri hedef alan bombardımanda beş gazeteci öldürülmüştü.
7 Ekim 2023'teki Hamas baskınıyla başlayan savaşta 74 bin 600'den fazla Filistinli hayatını kaybetti.
ABD, Türkiye, Mısır ve Katar arabuluculuğunda sağlanan ateşkese rağmen İsrail saldırılarını sürdürüyor ve bölgenin en az yüzde 60'ını kontrolü altında tutuyor.
Gazzeli sağlık yetkililerine göre, Ekim 2025'te yürürlüğe giren ateşkesten bu yana İsrail saldırılarında bin 622 kişi hayatını kaybetti.
Öte yandan konut altyapısı yok edilen Gazze'de yüz binlerce kişi, bu kış aylarını da enkaz yığınları arasına kurdukları çadırlarda geçirmek zorunda kalıyor.

Kanadalı madencilik ve enerji şirketi AtkinsRealis, Türkiye'nin nükleer enerji programını genişletme olasılığını değerlendirmek üzere Türkiye Nükleer Enerji AŞ (TÜNAŞ) ile bir fizibilite çalışması yürütmek için anlaşma imzaladığını açıkladı.
Anlaşma, AtkinsRealis'in iştiraki Candu Energy tarafından Antalya'da düzenlenen COP31 iklim zirvesi kapsamında imzalandı.
Reuters haber ajansının aktardığına göre şirket, açıklamasında nükleer santral projesi için 2027 sonuna kadar kapsamlı bir fizibilite çalışması tamamlayacağını ve ön mühendislik ve tasarım (FEED) çalışmaları yürüteceğini belirtti.
AtkinsRealis'in nükleer enerji biriminin başkanı Joe St. Julian, Reuters'a yaptığı açıklamada tarafların Türkiye'de toplam 4,5 gigavat kapasiteli, altı reaktörden oluşan bir santral planını görüştüğünü söyledi.
St. Julian, mühendislik ve tasarım çalışmasını 2028'e kadar tamamlamayı planladıklarını ve bu çalışmanın ardından nihai yatırım kararının alınacağını belirtti.
St. Julian, projenin finansmanı için izlenecek yol üzerinde de anlaşmaya varıldığını söyledi.
Türkiye, Rusya'nın Rosatom şirketinin Akdeniz kıyısındaki Mersin'de inşa ettiği 4,8 gigavat kapasiteli Akkuyu Nükleer Güç Santrali'nin ötesine geçerek nükleer enerji programını genişletmek istiyor.
Sinop ve Trakya yeni santraller için olası yerler olarak belirlendi.
Rusya Devlet Nükleer Enerji Kuruluşu Rosatom'un Genel Müdürü Aleksey Likhachev, 11 Kasım'da Akkuyu'daki ilk reaktörün bu yıl faaliyete geçirilmesi için çalışıldığını açıkladı.
Ankara, olası bir nükleer santral için Kanada, Güney Kore, Rusya, Japonya ve Çin'le görüştüğünü açıklamıştı.
Türkiye, nükleer alanda işbirliği için Kanada ve Güney Kore ile mutabakat zaptı imzaladı.
Finansman ve maliyetler bu süreçte belirleyici unsurlar arasında yer alıyor.
Enerji Bakanı Alparslan Bayraktar, geçen hafta Türkiye'nin ulusal enerji planını açıklarken Ankara'nın 2040'a kadar nükleer enerji kapasitesini 10 gigavata çıkarmayı hedeflediğini ve o tarihte elektrik talebinin yüzde 11'inin nükleer enerjiden karşılanmasını beklediğini söyledi.
Bayraktar, Sinop veya Trakya'daki santral planları için 2027'yi karar yılı olarak da nitelendirdi.

AK Parti Grup Başkanı Abdullah Güler, Yenilenebilir Enerji Kaynaklarının Elektrik Enerjisi Üretimi Amaçlı Kullanımına İlişkin Kanun ile Bazı Kanunlarda Değişiklik Yapılmasına Dair Kanun Teklifi 'nin TBMM Başkanlığına sunulduğunu bildirdi.
Güler, Meclis'te düzenlediği basın toplantısında, küresel iklim değişikliğiyle mücadelenin ve temiz enerji dönüşümünün, enerji arz güvenliğinin ve ekonomik rekabet gücünün temel belirleyicileri arasında yer aldığını belirtti.
Yenilenebilir Enerji Kaynaklarının Elektrik Enerjisi Üretimi Amaçlı Kullanımına İlişkin Kanun ile Bazı Kanunlarda Değişiklik Yapılmasına Dair Kanun Teklifi'nin TBMM Başkanlığına sunulduğunu bildiren Güler, teklifin 15 maddeden oluştuğunu kaydetti.
Teklifteki düzenlemeleri anlatan Güler, yüzen LNG tesislerinin arz güvenliği çerçevesinde EPDK kararıyla başka bölgelerde de hizmet vermesine imkan sağlanacağını aktardı.
Güler, 10 yılını tamamlayan lisanssız üretim tesislerinin lisanslı faaliyete geçiş şartlarını ve lisans alma bedellerinin nesnel kriterlere bağlanacağını belirtti.
Anayasa Mahkemesi'nin iptal kararı doğrultusunda, yönetmelikle düzenlenen Jandarma ve Sahil Güvenlik Akademisine ve Polis Meslek Yüksekokullarına öğrenci alımlarına yönelik hükümleri kanuni sisteme taşıyacaklarını aktaran Güler, Mesleki Eğitim Kanunu kapsamında aday çırak, çırak ve stajyer öğrencilere ödenen ücretlere ilişkin devlet katkısı uygulamasının sürdürülmesi amacıyla Cumhurbaşkanı'na tanınan uzatma yetkisini, her defasında bir eğitim-öğretim yılı olmak üzere 15 yıla çıkaracaklarını ifade etti.
Güler, İşsizlik Sigortası Kanunu kapsamındaki kadınların, gençlerin ve mesleki ve teknik eğitime ilişkin belge sahibi işsizlerin istihdamının desteklenmesi için verilen istihdam teşvikinin süresinin 31 Aralık 2028'e kadar uzatılacağını, Cumhurbaşkanı'na da bu süreyi 2029 sonuna kadar uzatma yetkisi verileceğini söyledi.
Genel Sağlık Sigortası (GSS) prim borçlarına yönelik de düzenleme yapılacağını anlatan Güler, şunları kaydetti:
"1 Ocak 2017 tarihinden öncesine ait ödenmemiş Genel Sağlık Sigortası prim borçları ile bunlara bağlı gecikme cezası ve zamlarının tamamının tahsilinden vazgeçiyoruz. Bu bağlamda 2 milyon 199 bin 869 vatandaşımızın toplamda 5 milyar 627 milyon 666 bin lira tutarındaki prim borcunu terkin ederek, üzerindeki borç yükünü kaldırıyor, sağlık hizmetlerine yine kesintisiz ve kolay erişimi teminat altına alıyoruz. Kamu üniversite sağlık hizmeti sunucularımızın 2026 yılı götürü bedel sözleşmelerinden kaynaklanan tahakkuk farklarını terkin ederek, hastanelerimizin finansal sürdürülebilirliğini ve sağlık hizmetinin devamını sağlamış oluyoruz."
Tasfiyesine Karar Verilen Bazı Yatırım Fonları Hakkında Kanun'un yürürlüğe girdiğini anımsatan Güler, tasfiye kapsamındaki 7 portföy şirketi bünyesindeki 131 fonun pay sahiplerine yapılan ödemelerde, fon mal varlığı, geri kazanım hesaplarındaki kaynaklar ve diğer isteğe bağlı iade hesaplarındaki tutarların ödemelerde esas alındığını kaydetti.
Güler, fonların tasfiyesinde, kamu bütçesinden kaynak kullanılmadığını ve kullanılmayacağını vurgulayarak, şunları ifade etti:
"Olağan tasfiye kapsamı içerisinde 93 fonda 71 bin 899 hesaba 68 milyar lira doğrudan ödeme yapılmıştır. Olağanüstü tasfiye kapsamında ise 4 Kasım 2026 itibarıyla 15 fonda 542 bin 975 hesaba toplam 62,2 milyar lira ara ödeme yapılmıştır. Dolayısıyla, bugüne kadar toplam 131 fonun 108 fonunda, 614 bin 874 hesaba, 420 bin 31 tekil kişiye 130,2 milyar lira ödeme yapılmıştır ve toplamda 179 bin 449 kişi net yatırım tutarının tamamını almıştır. Yarın hem Fon Koordinasyon Kurulu toplantısı gerçekleştirecek hem de yeni ikinci plan ödemesi ilan edilecektir. Bu süreçle beraber sermaye piyasalarında güveni artıracak, hukuki belirlilik ve şeffaflığı güçlendirecek manada kanun hazırlıklarımız devam ediyor. Görevlendirdiğimiz milletvekilleriyle beraber sermaye piyasalarında hukuki güvenliği ve şeffaflığı artıracak kanun teklifimizi de yakın zamanda bitirip, Meclis Başkanlığına sunmayı arzu ediyoruz."
Teklifle, Tasfiyesine Karar Verilen Bazı Yatırım Fonları Hakkında Kanun kapsamında ödemelerin hızlı ve şeffaf yapılması amacıyla asli görev alanları olmamasına rağmen, Kanunla kendisine tevdi edilen olağanüstü tasfiye ve devir süreçlerini yürüten bankaların, çalışanların, işlem tesis eden personelin korunmasını amaçladıklarını aktaran Güler, kanun teklifiile olağanüstü tasfiye işlemlerini yürütenlere mali ve idari sorumsuzluk getirileceğini, konusu suç teşkil eden işlemlerin istisna olacağını belirtti.
Fon soruşturması kapsamında listenin açıklanıp açıklanmayacağının sorulması üzerine Güler, şunları kaydetti:
"Ben de bu listenin açıklanmasını isterim. Ancak 455 bin 578 kişi var, bu fonlara girmişler, yatırım aracı olarak paralarını yatırmışlar. Sonradan İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının yürüttüğü soruşturma kapsamında görevini kötüye kullanan, ihmal eden, farklı niyetler taşıyan, Sermaye Piyasaları Kanunu'nun yaptırıma tabi kıldığı piyasa bozucu eylemlerde bulunan, içeriden sahte bilgi taşıyan veya piyasa dolandırıcılığı yapmak suretiyle bu işlemlere imza atan, bu konularda yasa dışı faaliyetlerde bulunan insanlar kimler? Biz 455 bin 578 kişinin hepsinin bu 'fon dolandırıcılığı' dediğimiz olaylara karıştığını düşünebilir miyiz? Bu liste kesinleşsin. Ben bu listenin açıklanmasını isterim."
Fon soruşturması kapsamında "masumiyet karinesi" ve "lekelenmeme hakkı" göz önüne alınarak, Sermaye Piyasası Kanunu'na karşı eylemlerin belirlenmesi gerektiğini kaydeden Güler, şöyle devam etti:
"Bunları belirlemeden sadece 'fona para yatırdı' diye insanları suçlayabilir miyiz? O listeyi neye göre hazırlayacağız? Kim hangi eylemi işlemişse, hangi sorumluluğu varsa, bu liste açıklansın. Ancak liste diye yarın, bir gün utanacağımız, mahcup olacağımız isimleri de lekelemeyelim. Benim kaygım bu. Çok sayıda insan var, çok kritik incelemeler yapılıyor."
İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının soruşturması kapsamında 100'ün üzerinde kişinin tutuklandığını hatırlatan Güler, her bir fonun, hesabın tek tek incelendiğini aktardı.
"Cumhurbaşkanı'mızın bize talimatıdır, kendisinin de ifadesidir, sonuna kadar kim hangi eylemiyle, hangi suça karışmışsa, konumu, özelliği hiçbir şekilde fark etmeksizin, sonuna kadar gideceğiz. Açık yüreklilikle söylüyorum." ifadesini kullanan Güler, muhalefetin bazı isimleri dile getirdiğini, sonra ortaya atılan iddiaların isim benzerliği olduğunun ortaya çıktığını, bakanların suçlandığını hatırlattı.

Düzenlemenin 1 Ocak 2027 tarihinden itibaren uygulanması planlanıyor.

IRNA, İran 'ın güneyinde yer alan Sirik şehrine yönelik bir saldırı düzenlendiğini bildirdi.
IRNA'nın İranlı yetkililere dayandırdığı bilgiye göre; Hürmüzgan eyaletinde bulunan Sirik şehri "bir düşman" saldırısında hedef alındı.
Saldırının askeri nitelikte olduğunu ifade edilirken, olası hasar veya can kaybına ilişkin bir detay verilmedi.

İsrail devlet televizyonu KAN, İsrail'in geçici Başbakanı Binyamin Netanyahu ile hükümet kurma yetkisi alan Yashar Partisi lideri Gadi Eisenkot arasındaki güvenlik brifinginin sona ermesinin hemen ardından yayınladığı haberde, ABD'den İsrail'e İran'a yeni saldırılara hazır olunması yönünde mesaj iletildiğini iddia etti.
ABD'li bir kaynağa dayandırılan habere göre, son günlerde CENTCOM, Tel Aviv'e İran'a yönelik saldırıların yeniden başlatılmasına hazırlıklı olma yönünde uyarıda bulundu.
"Yeni bir savaşa hazırlıklı olunması gerektiği" yönündeki mesajın, İsrail'in yanı sıra Körfez ülkelerine de iletildiği ileri sürülen haberde, bölge ülkelerine iletilen mesajların, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran'a saldırıların yeniden başlatılmasına gerek olmadığına yönelik son açıklamalarıyla çeliştiğine dikkati çekildi.
Washington yönetiminin Orta Doğu'ya askeri kaynak aktarmaya devam ettiği aktarılan haberde, ABD'nin Orta Doğu ve Avrupa'daki üslerinde yaklaşık 200 yakıt ikmal uçağının bulunduğu belirtildi.
Haberde, ABD'nin bölgede George Washington ve George Bush adlı iki uçak gemisinin bulunduğu, üçüncü uçak gemisi Roosevelt'in gelecek hafta Umman açıklarına varmasının beklendiği kaydedildi.
İsrail basını da, seçimlerin ardından Genelkurmay Başkanı Eyal Zamir'in İsrail Başbakanı Binyamin Netanyahu'nun İran'a saldırı planlarına itiraz ettiğini ve bu konuda anlaşmazlık yaşadığını ileri sürmüş, buna karşın Netanyahu'nun İran'a saldırı niyetinde olduğunu iddia etmişti.
İsrail'de hükümet kurmakla görevlendirilen Yashar Partisi lideri Eisenkot​​​​​​​, Netanyahu'ya acil olmayan askeri eylemlere kalkışmama uyarısında bulunmuş ve bir güvenlik brifingi istemişti.
İsrail Savunma Bakanı Yisrael Katz, Genelkurmay Başkanı ve güvenlik yetkilileriyle durum değerlendirme toplantısı yapmıştı.
İçişleri Bakanlığı, "Kırmızı bültenle uluslararası seviyede aranan ve 116 suçtan aranma kaydı bulunan yeni nesil organize suç örgütü elebaşı Sercan Sayal, Yunanistan'dan ülkemize getiriliyor." açıklamasında bulundu.

Türkiye, nükleer enerji kapasitesini artırma planları kapsamında Kanada merkezli AtkinsRéalis ile olası yeni bir nükleer santral projesine yönelik fizibilite çalışması yapılması için anlaşma imzaladı.
Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Alparslan Bayraktar’ın Mart ayının başlarında gerçekleştirdiği Kanada ziyaretinde, AtkinsRéalis ile Türkiye Nükleer Enerji AŞ (TÜNAŞ) arasında “Nükleer Enerji İş Birliği'ne İlişkin Mutabakat Zaptı” imzalanmıştı.
Anlaşma, ön fizibilite aşamasının ardından CANDU reaktör teknolojisine odaklanan kapsamlı fizibilite çalışmasını ve ön tasarım mühendisliğini kapsıyor. Bu kapsamda Türkiye'de kurulabilecek yeni bir nükleer santral projesinin teknik ve ekonomik açıdan değerlendirilmesi hedefleniyor.
Çalışmalarda santral için uygun sahanın belirlenmesi, CANDU reaktör teknolojisinin seçilen sahaya uyarlanması ve santralin işletilmesine ilişkin teknik konuların yanı sıra projenin finansman modeli ve ekonomik boyutu da ele alınacak.
AtkinsRéalis'in perşembe günü yaptığı açıklamada, anlaşmanın şirketin iştiraki Candu Energy ile Türkiye'nin kamuya ait nükleer enerji şirketi TÜNAŞ arasında imzalandığı belirtildi. Açıklamaya göre çalışma, nükleer enerji programının genişletilmesine yönelik çok üniteli bir projenin kapsamlı fizibilite incelemesini ve ön mühendislik tasarımını içeriyor.
Antalya'da düzenlenen Birleşmiş Milletler İklim Değişikliği Konferansı COP31 kapsamında imzalanan anlaşma doğrultusunda fizibilite çalışmasının 2027 sonuna kadar tamamlanması hedefleniyor.
AtkinsRéalis'in Nükleer Enerji Başkanı Joe St. Julian, Reuters'a yaptığı açıklamada, tarafların Türkiye'de altı reaktörlü ve toplam 4,5 gigavat kapasiteli bir santral planı üzerinde görüştüğünü söyledi. St. Julian, mühendislik tasarım çalışmasının 2028'e kadar tamamlanmasının, ardından da nihai yatırım kararının alınmasının hedeflendiğini belirtti.
St. Julian, proje için bir finansman yol haritası üzerinde de anlaşmaya varıldığını ifade etti.
Türkiye, yeni nükleer santral projeleri için Kanada'nın yanı sıra Güney Kore, Rusya, Japonya ve Çin ile de görüşmeler yürütüyor. Ankara, Kanada ve Güney Kore ile nükleer enerji alanında işbirliğine yönelik mutabakat zaptları imzaladı. Projelerin finansmanı ve maliyeti ise karar sürecinde öne çıkan başlıklar arasında yer alıyor.
Güney Kore ile yürütülen temaslarda da son dönemde ilerleme kaydedildi. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan'ın 3 Kasım'da Seul'de Güney Kore Cumhurbaşkanı Lee Jae-myung ile yaptığı görüşmenin ardından, TÜNAŞ ile Kore İhracat-İthalat Bankası (Korea Eximbank) arasında nükleer enerji projelerinin finansmanında işbirliğine yönelik bir mutabakat zaptı imzalandı.
Mutabakat, TÜNAŞ'ın yürüteceği olası nükleer santral projeleri için finansman seçeneklerinin değerlendirilmesini öngörüyor. Lee, Sinop'ta planlanan santral projesine yönelik işbirliğinin sorunsuz ilerlediğini, saha değerlendirmeleri ve ortak çalışma grubunun faaliyetlerinin sürdüğünü söylemişti.
Bununla birlikte Türkiye, Sinop projesi için henüz nihai bir ortak seçmiş değil. Erdoğan daha önce yaptığı açıklamalarda Güney Kore'yi olası ortaklardan biri olarak değerlendirdiklerini belirtmiş; finansman koşulları, elektrik üretim maliyetleri ve projenin Türkiye ekonomisine sağlayacağı katkının karar sürecinde etkili olacağını söylemişti.
Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Bayraktar, geçen hafta açıkladığı Ulusal Enerji Planı kapsamında Türkiye'nin nükleer enerji kapasitesini 2040'a kadar 10 gigavata çıkarmayı hedeflediğini duyurmuştu. Nükleer enerjinin aynı yıl ülkenin elektrik talebinin yüzde 11'ini karşılaması öngörülüyor.
Bayraktar, Sinop veya Trakya'da kurulması planlanan yeni santrallerle ilgili kararların 2027 yılında alınmasının hedeflendiğini de söylemişti.
Türkiye'nin ilk nükleer santrali Akkuyu'da ise Rusya'nın Rosatom şirketi tarafından yürütülen inşaat çalışmaları sürüyor. Reuters'ın aktardığına göre Rosatom, ilk reaktörün 2026 bitmeden kendi kendini sürdüren nükleer zincirleme reaksiyona ulaşmasını bekliyor.

De Bruyne, "Doğru zamanda doğru yerdeydim, goller attım. Arda Güler muhteşem bir futbolcu. Türkiye'de gözümüz hep onun üzerindeydi. Diğer takım arkadaşları daha fazla sorumluluk almalı. Çünkü bütün sorumluluk Arda'nın üzerindeydi. Biz de planımızı ona göre yaptık" ifadelerini kullandı.

Jensen Huang stepped down as the chief executive of Nvidia on Thursday, four days after the company announced its internal investigation into an affair he had with Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, an alleged asset of China’s Ministry of State Security.
“Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately,” the Nvidia board said in a statement. Nvidia’s chief financial officer, Colette Kress, will serve as interim CEO. The board said it “will consider internal and external candidates” for a permanent replacement.
The board’s investigation was announced on November 8, slightly less than two weeks after The New York Times reported that the chief executive had been the target of a Chinese intelligence operation facilitated through his relationship with Alice Huang, who has no known relation to Jensen. The pair have been spotted in public together at least twice, in June 2024 and May 2025 . On November 11, The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang also allegedly had a relationship with a direct report at Nvidia.
The alleged relationship with a subordinate, along with Huang’s business dealings with Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI company where Alice Huang previously held a senior position, likely played a greater role in the board’s decision to oust Huang than the Chinese espionage allegations, a source familiar with the matter tells WIRED.
US intelligence officials reportedly briefed President Donald Trump on Huang’s relationship with Alice last year, but the president did not act on it. On November 6, The New York Times and Financial Times reported that Alice was a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security and that she had been recruited to collect information on the Nvidia executive. (The Chinese government has rejected all claims that Alice was a spy for the country. )
Huang sent a companywide email on Sunday acknowledging his affair, apologizing to his family and Nvidia employees, and pledging cooperation with the internal investigation. The executive has been married to his wife, Lori Huang, since 1985 , and both of the couple’s two children work at the company.
On Monday, WIRED exclusively reported that last year Huang began working with a crisis PR firm to manage his personal communications. In October 2025, those PR consultants started to be looped in on all press inquiries involving Huang, whether those inquiries were personal or professional in nature.
The timing lines up with a New York Times report that month that the US Commerce Department was investigating whether Alice Huang’s Megaspeed was helping Chinese companies get around American export controls with the help of a vast web of subsidiaries. The investigation was reportedly halted and transferred to the Justice Department after Nvidia general counsel Tim Teter inquired about it.
Huang has been a vocal critic of these export controls, which he argues unnecessarily constrain the market for American chips, create discrete Chinese and American tech ecosystems, and spur China to build competitive chips of its own. Huang has worked to develop a relationship with Trump in order to advocate for policies that are advantageous for Nvidia, including the idea of opening its markets to China.
Huang cofounded Nvidia in 1993 with friends Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem. The trio reportedly brainstormed their vision for the company in a Denny’s diner and aspired to bring realistic 3D graphics to personal computers. For the first few decades of its existence, Nvidia was primarily known in the gaming community for creating chips powerful enough to render high-quality in-game graphics.
In 2012, after a new kind of neural network known as AlexNet won a high-profile prize in computer vision, Nvidia pivoted from high-speed computer graphics to building chips that would support artificial intelligence. Huang has repeatedly said that the introduction of AlexNet, which was developed by AI engineers Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, and Geoffrey Hinton, was a “Big Bang”–like event for computing.
Because its new GPUs proved highly effective at powering AI models that require massive amounts of processing power, the value of Nvidia shares soared in 2023 and 2024, in lockstep with the broader AI boom that began sweeping through the world economy. In the summer of 2025, Nvidia became the first company in history to cross $4 trillion in value.
As of September 2026, the company controlled about 90 percent of the GPU market. Much of Nvidia’s epic rise over the few decades has been attributed not just to its cutting-edge chips and its software “moat,” CUDA, that keeps developers locked into those chips, but also to the fast-thinking, controlling, charismatic, and often bombastic leadership style of Huang himself. Now, that critical part of the company’s success is out.

Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has resigned following revelations that he had two extramarital affairs, plunging the chipmaker at the heart of the global AI boom into crisis.
The 63-year-old will be replaced by chief financial officer Colette Kress, who will serve as interim chief executive.
His exit comes after he admitted to having a relationship with a woman that US authorities believe was a Chinese spy. It also emerged on Wednesday that Huang had an affair with a senior Nvidia executive.
Nvidia shares were down more than 10 percent in pre-market trading, extending earlier losses after the announcement of Huang’s resignation.
Huang, who cofounded Nvidia in 1993, led it to become what was until recently the world’s most valuable company.
Huang’s departure marks a startling end to his more than 33-year tenure, during which Nvidia evolved from a small video-game chip company into the linchpin of the global AI infrastructure boom.
Huang has become one of the most recognizable figures in tech, as Nvidia’s semiconductors became integral to training and running AI systems such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude.
Nvidia stock extended its pre-market decline after the company announced that Jensen Huang had resigned as chief executive.
Shares were down 10.2 percent in pre-market trading, a move that would wipe off more than $400 billion in market capitalization.
This story was updated on November 12 with news of Huang’s resignation.

texts.https://www.wired.com/story/who-is-colet:
Nvidia’s CEO and cofounder Jensen Huang is officially out , and longtime chief financial officer Colette Kress is in. The chipmaker’s board of directors announced Thursday that Kress, who joined Nvidia in 2013, has been named interim CEO following Huang’s resignation amid a scandal over his extramarital affair with a Chinese businesswoman believed by US officials to be an asset of China’s Ministry of State Security.
Harvey Jones, the newly appointed chair of Nvidia’s board, said in a statement that Kress “has helped lead Nvidia through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position.” He added that Kress will be supported by an “experienced leadership team” and that the board has “full confidence” in her.
Kress was among the most obvious candidates to fill the void after Huang’s departure, according to multiple tech executives and industry analysts who follow Nvidia closely, given her long tenure at the company, credibility on Wall Street and across the tech industry, and, perhaps most importantly, her deep familiarity with Nvidia’s business and finances.
“She’s extremely strong-willed, professional, and whip-smart. She doesn’t tolerate nonsense. She can be friendly and gracious too,” says a former Nvidia executive who spoke on the condition of anonymity. “She obviously has a keen sense for how Jensen thinks.”
“Colette is the logical choice,” says Patrick Moorhead, founder and chief analyst at Moor Insights & Strategies, who has tracked the chip industry for decades. “She has credibility with investors because she answers hard questions directly.”
Moorhead says Kress has operated as much more than a “numbers” CFO. “In my conversations with her, she goes deep on the product road map, from rack-scale systems to networking and software,” he says.
Nvidia’s board said on Sunday it was launching an independent investigation into Huang’s activities following a report by The New York Times that he had an affair with a woman named Alice Huang, who US officials suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset. WIRED reported on Monday that Huang quietly hired a crisis communications firm sometime last year to handle matters related to his personal life. By October of 2025, the firm was being looped in on all press inquiries involving Huang at Nvidia, around the same time The New York Times reported that US authorities were investigating whether a company linked to Alice Huang had helped Chinese firms evade US chip export controls through its subsidiaries.
While Huang has long been the public face of Nvidia, Kress has been responsible for managing the chipmaker’s relationship with Wall Street. On earnings calls, she often details Nvidia’s financial performance, customer demand, supply constraints, and other key metrics.
“One of the things we don’t focus on is the stock price. We focus on our investors and how we would like to innovate,” Kress told the Israeli business newspaper Globes in 2023.
Before joining Nvidia, Kress spent more than two decades in finance roles at Microsoft, Cisco, and Texas Instruments. Huang personally recruited her in 2013, when Nvidia was still best known for its gaming graphics cards, according to Globes. Huang laid out his vision for the company’s future on a whiteboard, explaining how Nvidia could become a major supplier of computing infrastructure for artificial intelligence.
Other potential successors to Huang included Ian Buck, an Nvidia veteran of more than 20 years who created the company’s software platform CUDA and now oversees its high-performance computing business, and Jeff Fisher, who joined Nvidia in 1994 as the head of software sales and later became senior vice president of its GeForce unit, where he led Nvidia’s strategy for bringing GPUs to market.
However, Nvidia’s unusual corporate structure has long meant that dozens of executives reported directly to Huang. The company lacks a traditional chief operating officer. Even executive vice presidents aren’t necessarily given direct control over budgets, sources have told WIRED. As a result, few people within the organization have the same level of understanding of the company’s financials as Kress.
The former Nvidia executive who spoke to WIRED on the condition of anonymity said that while Kress is incredibly sharp and “can step into the [CEO] role immediately without needing any guidance,” she doesn’t have the same engineering and technical expertise that Huang brought to the role. She has also shied away from being “at the center of public attention,” the person said.
Given the intense scrutiny surrounding Huang lately, that leadership style might be a welcome temporary change for Nvidia.
texts.https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/jensen:
The Nvidia Board of Directors announced on Thursday morning that the company’s co-founder and CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately.
This is a shocking twist for one of the most valuable companies in the world, which designs the chips that make the AI boom possible. Few people would have predicted this turn of events even just a week ago, as Huang has been so central to Nvidia throughout the company’s existence that he never even established a succession plan . But Huang has now been ousted after reports that he had affairs with both an alleged Chinese spy and one of his direct reports at Nvidia.
While the company conducts a more thorough search for Huang’s successor, Nvidia CFO and Executive Vice President Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO. But beyond her name and job title, what do we know about the person who will now lead a company worth about $3.8 trillion?
According to Nvidia’s website , Kress has worked at the company since September 2013. Before that, she spent three years as an SVP and CFO of Cisco’s Business Technology Operations Finance organization. She also worked at Microsoft for 13 years, where she spent four years as CFO of the Server and Tools division. She holds a finance degree from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University.
The California-based 59-year-old has a very limited social media presence — on Linkedin , she has commented some well wishes on former colleagues’ posts about their retirement. But as CFO, she’s been a regular presence on Nvidia’s earnings calls, making her a familiar figure for analysts covering the company.
According to Forbes’ list of America’s Richest Self-Made Women, Kress’ net worth is estimated to be about $1.2 billion. Her Forbes profile adds that she initially joined Nvidia in part because her two sons endorsed the company for its role in the video game industry, which it was best known for at the time.
“Nvidias strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years,” Kress said in a statement . “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.”
Nvidia is slated to report its quarterly earnings on Tuesday, when we will likely hear more from Kress about her plans for the company’s immediate future.

Microsoft said its Outlook email service is currently experiencing an outage, preventing both business and consumer users from accessing their inboxes.
The issue was initially flagged as affecting the U.S. and the Americas, and later expanded to affect “any region.”
Microsoft hasn’t given a specific cause, but said that it was providing updates in its admin center , which wasn’t reachable at the time of publication. In a post on X for users who can’t access the admin center, Microsoft said some of its infrastructure was experiencing “elevated load,” and that it was “redistributing connection traffic across our broader worldwide infrastructure to help balance the load.”
In its latest update, Microsoft attributed this incident to “a large number of servers being unexpectedly unavailable,” for reasons it did not explain. Microsoft said it continues to investigate the outage.
Microsoft says its video conferencing tool Teams, file sharing platform SharePoint, and its AI tool Copilot are also unavailable. The company says its Defender XDR security system is also affected by the outage.
Consumers are also unable to access their OneDrive storage, Office (for the web), and several other Microsoft services during the ongoing outage.
TechCrunch will reach out to Microsoft for comment, as soon as our own email service has resumed.
The company’s last major incident was in September , when a days-long outage hit Microsoft 365, its online productivity suite that includes Outlook. During that outage, Microsoft blamed a “core authentication configuration” issue that prevented users from accessing the service.

Microsoft says servers unexpectedly went offline, disrupting Outlook email, Teams, Copilot and other services.
Thousands of Microsoft users reported trouble accessing their email and connecting to work apps after a widespread outage hit Outlook and other services on Thursday.
Reports of problems with Outlook, the company’s email client, climbed to about 130,000 on the outage tracking site Downdetector shortly after 1pm Eastern Time (18:00 GMT), with some users saying emails weren’t being sent or received, while others couldn’t open their inboxes.
By just before 3pm (20:00 GMT), that figure had fallen to about 77,000.
Users also reported having trouble accessing Microsoft’s workplace messaging app Teams and its AI assistant Copilot, along with other Microsoft 365 services. The company said the issues could impact users in any region.
Microsoft said on X that servers were unavailable and failing automatic health checks, putting pressure on those still operating. It said it was testing a configuration change to redistribute traffic that was elevated on parts of its infrastructure and restarting affected services to bring them back online.
“We’re working to safely return them to service,” the company said.
Microsoft did not state when it expected services to be fully restored.
texts.https://www.wired.com/story/major-micros:
It’s not just you. Microsoft’s 365 business and enterprise services suffered a major outage on Thursday, preventing users of its popular cloud suite from accessing their accounts.
Around 10:40 am ET on Thursday, Microsoft posted on its 365 status page on X that it was “investigating reports of users experiencing issues when accessing or using Microsoft Teams functionality in North America.” By just before 1 pm ET, it said it was aware of “issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods in the Americas.”
Microsoft later said that its network was also “experiencing elevated load across multiple regions, which is likely contributing to the connectivity errors,” but that the issue was related to servers going offline, not due to increased traffic.
Around an hour later, Microsoft said it had “begun redistributing connection traffic across our broader worldwide infrastructure to help balance the load” and was “aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact.”
“We've paused all deployments. We're moving additional traffic off the affected infrastructure, and we're restarting affected servers to return them to service,” Microsoft wrote.
In an update on its status page , Microsoft said impacted services may include Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Copilot 365, and Microsoft Defender XDR.
“We are aware and investigating reports of users experiencing issues with Microsoft 365 services, primarily issues with Exchange Online,” a Microsoft spokesperson tells WIRED in a statement. “We appreciate our customer's patience while we work to restore services as soon as possible.”
Outage reports on the service uptime tracking website Downdetector began falling around 1:15 pm ET after a large spike in users reporting issues with Outlook and other Microsoft 365 products around noon.
It is currently unclear when the outage may be over or what its cause may be. In a status update on X posted just before 3 pm ET, Microsoft said “a problem” was “causing servers to fail automated health checks and become unavailable” but that it was attempting to reboot its systems to hopefully bring them back online.
Outages in cloud services occur frequently, and their causes can vary. Configuration errors, resolution issues with the Domain Name System, and cyberattacks can all cause connection errors. There is currently no indication that a cyberattack caused the current Microsoft outage.
While major Microsoft outages are relatively rare, they are far from unprecedented. In July 2024, a corrupted update from the security firm CrowdStrike caused the “blues screen of death” on Windows machines around the world, while a separate but nearly simultaneous outage knocked out Microsoft Azure services for hours , causing untold millions of dollars in lost revenue due to companies’ inability to function as normal.

Updated 11/12/2026 at 5:20 pm ET: WIRED updated the article to clarify that the Azure outage was unrelated to the CrowdStrike-related issues with Windows in 2024.

Whoop , the maker of screen-less fitness bands, is launching a social network on Thursday that lets its members follow friends and family and share their health data.
The network, called Whoop Humans, will be rolled out in the Whoop app to members at every membership tier at no extra cost. Members can follow anyone on Whoop and choose what to share, from sleep and recovery to workouts and achievements. Followers can react and comment; members can also attach photos and commentary to their data. It’s all opt-in, CEO Will Ahmed tells us.
Whoop already has a social feature, Teams, which a little more than half its customers use, according to the company. But Teams is built around groups and leaderboards, and everyone in a group sees everyone else’s information. Humans is meant to be more intimate. Members decide who follows them and who sees what, so a trainer can track a set of clients without the clients seeing one another’s data, for example.
I found myself questioning how much a spouse wants to know about the other’s sleep score when Ahmed mentioned this particular scenario, so I asked him how else beta members used these newer social features. He said the company learned that people were more engaged when someone reported a low recovery score than a nearly perfect one, suggesting that the new feature may be particularly helpful for understanding when someone is struggling and might need attention.
Indeed, the bigger story here is where Whoop continues to be headed, which is into medical wellness. Like its most direct rival, Oura, the company is pushing faster and more aggressively into the wellness opportunity that an aging population presents.
Whoop had already added FDA-cleared ECG and atrial fibrillation detection, blood pressure insights, blood testing, and medical-record uploads. Asked if older customers are gravitating to Whoop, Ahmed said, without offering specifics, that Whoop has seen “huge growth” among people over 60 over the past 18 months. He also said his was among the first companies accepted into a Medicare program that reimburses qualifying wearables that can show they improve health outcomes, and that it now has Medicare members.
He added that he expects families to be big users of Humans. (You can imagine adult children checking in on aging parents.)
But the company’s efforts to be thought of as the “brand for personal health” raises questions, naturally, about privacy. Ahmed said members choose which metrics to share, can remove followers, and can switch on “stealth mode” to go dark for a few days without changing their settings. Activities marked sensitive aren’t shared by default, and Ahmed said health alerts and medical information aren’t shared at all. Members can also report any comment or photo that they deem disturbing, and the company said reported content is reviewed.
As for minors, Whoop’s minimum age is 13 for all members (higher in some countries), meaning customers of that age can share their data subject to consents and privacy settings. Asked whether a parent could follow a teenager’s data, he didn’t answer directly and pointed to the privacy controls.
Ahmed also said Whoop doesn’t sell member data. “Our product is not you; it’s the membership,” he said, adding that the company doesn’t license data to third parties.
He was candid about dealmaking. Asked about Oura’s announcement this week that it will pay $625 million for Counsel Health , a service offering on-demand physicians, Ahmed said he expects “more consolidation” among AI-focused, clinician-focused, and wearable companies, and that Whoop is always on the prowl. Its deep relationship with members, he said, puts it “in a position to be an acquirer.”
He was more guarded about the company’s own finances, declining to share revenue or say whether Whoop is profitable. He did say that the company now has about 1,200 employees, membership on its software platform has increased more than 70% a year for three years running, and that it expects to have nearly 4 million members by year-end.
As for an IPO (the company raised a very big round earlier this year), he said only that Whoop “will certainly IPO in the future.” He also wouldn’t comment on Oura, which shelved its own IPO of up to $2.2 billion in September citing market uncertainty.
In the meantime, Whoop is widening its reach. The company announced that its devices will be sold through Ulta stores beginning next March (around 500 locations of the beauty retailer to start, and a target to retail in more than a thousand stores eventually). Indeed, Ahmed said Whoop’s female audience has more than doubled from last year.
As for competition, in addition to Google’s new Fitbit Air band, Whoop may soon have to contend with Apple, which is reportedly developing a Whoop-style band . But Ahmed mostly shrugged off those concerns, suggesting that building a product doesn’t guarantee success. Instead, he said, Whoop’s job is to stay true to the “aspiring” people it serves.

Jensen Huang, who built Nvidia into the world’s dominant AI chipmaker, is stepping down as CEO after a second affair came to light. DW examines how losing its figurehead will affect the firm and the US-China AI race.
Nvidia's board met late Wednesday to decide on CEO Jensen Huang's future after reports emerged of a second extramarital affair — this time with an employee.
In a statement issued on Thursday morning, the world's most valuable chip supplier said Huang was resigning as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately.
The firm added that current Vice President and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Colette Kress would become interim CEO.
Under Nvidia's bylaws, Huang can be removed "with or without cause" by a majority vote of its 11 directors.
The New York Times first reported on the latest scandal, alleging that the 63-year-old Huang had an affair a senior Nvidia executive who reported directly to him.
Both are married; Huang tied the knot with his wife Lori in 1985.
The latest revelation emerged just three days after Huang admitted a relationship with a Chinese woman, whom United States intelligence agencies believe was spying for China . The woman, Alice Huang — no relation — is a former executive at Megaspeed , a Singapore-based cloud computing firm that runs artificial intelligence (AI) data centers across Southeast Asia and is a major client of Nvidia.
The US government is investigating the startup on suspicion that it secretly sent some of its Nvidia chips to China, violating Washington's curbs on high-end semiconductors.
Those advanced Nvidia processors ‌are ​used to train and run the large AI models behind chatbots and other generative AI products.
Megaspeed denies the allegations and on Thursday pledged to cooperate with US investigators. Huang, the alleged spy, has been barred from entering Singapore and Taiwan — a key chipmaking island.
While Nvidia's board backed its CEO after the first scandal emerged, market watchers believe the second caused too much reputational damage to one of the world's top three companies by market value.
According to The Wall Street Journal , Huang doesn't believe in formal succession planning, so with little notice, Nvidia appointed CFO Kress as interim CEO.
Bloomberg reported Wednesday that Nvidia’s board is working with advisers to identify potential permanent successors.
Kress, other senior Nvidia executives and members of Huang's own family have been mooted as replacements. The family members include his daughter Madison, a senior director of product marketing, and his son Spencer, who currently works in the firm's robotics division.
Rumors also abound over a longer-term solution. On India's CNBC-TV18, Jeffrey Sonnenfeld from the Yale School of Management floated former Apple CEO Tim Cook and ex-Google CEO Eric Schmidt.

The scandals have certainly hit Nvidia's market value. Since the first extramarital affair emerged on Sunday, the chipmaker's market capitalization has fallen by well over $600 billion to $4.2 trillion.
Nvidia shares were down more than 9% in premarket trading Thursday, after dropping by 10% earlier this week. Some analysts expect the stock price to struggle in the short term.
Nvidia stock hit all-time highs just a month ago as US technology giants continued to announce billions in spending on AI infrastructure. Still, Nvidia's stock hit all-time highs only a month ago, as US technology giants kept announcing billions in spending on AI infrastructure.
Demand for Nvidia's advanced chips is so high that many market analysts expect little impact on near-term sales. — meaning demand for Nvidia's advanced chips is so high that many market analysts expect little impact on near-term sales.
"While Jensen [Huang] is the heart and lungs of the Nvidia story…the company and its leading-edge GPU technology will go on and [his departure] does not change the entrenched position Nvidia has in the AI Revolution chip arms race," said Dan Ives, a partner, senior managing director and tech analyst at Yorkville Ives, a US-based merchant bank
Analysts see the biggest long-term risk in strategy and execution. After all, Huang was the leader who picked which ideas Nvidia should bet heavily on and got the whole company behind them.
His sudden exit is also seen as highly disruptive to the chip designer's strong relationships with AI hyperscalers, Taiwanese chip producer TSMC and foreign governments — especially China.
Huang was Nvidia's main lobbyist on US chip export rules and persuaded US President Donald Trump to ease some curbs on China last year.
Huang is often called a rockstar CEO for his leather jackets instead of suits.
Like Elon Musk of Tesla and SpaceX, he was also seen as a key-person risk as Nvidia’s public image, strategic direction and technical decisions became closely tied to him.
Huang steered the company for more than three decades and was also respected for his hands-on involvement in product architecture and engineering decisions.
He also insisted on a flat management structure, with around 60 executives reporting directly to him.
Huang has run the company so tightly around his own technical judgment and product decisions that investors may have little sense of how it would function without him.
At the same time, Nvidia is no longer the startup Huang founded in 1993. The company has built deep expertise in chip design and software, creating a durable moat that helps protect its huge profits, which topped $120.1 billion last year.
Some analysts argue that its central role in the AI hardware buildout makes it less dependent on Huang’s day-to-day input.
China is quickly playing catch-up with the US in the global race for AI dominance.
While Chinese AI models have lagged behind the likes of ChatGPT and Claude, recent updates from DeepSeek, Alibaba and Moonshot have closed much of the gap on benchmark tests and often beat US rivals on cost and speed.
Beijing is also investing heavily in domestic chips and data centers to reduce reliance on US hardware.
The US has curbed exports to China of Nvidia's most advanced AI chips .
However, this move has only slowed the pace of China's AI ambitions.
Reuters reported Thursday that Chinese AI firms are now trying to rent Nvidia-powered computing capacity at data centers outside China, amid fears the US could further tighten restrictions on advanced chips.
Also Thursday, Beijing accused the US of using the Nvidia spying claims as a pretext to impose a technological "blockade" on China.
The issue is likely to dominate talks next week between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC gathering in Shenzhen in southern China.

Google Search is getting better at understanding complicated questions, including those with multiple parts, highly specific requests, or confusing typos. The updates are coming via the company’s newly released Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, which Google claims is its “biggest model improvement to Search yet.”
While Google’s frontier models, Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, are best at deep reasoning for hard problems, Hydrogen is designed for fast execution across a variety of agentic workflows, or tasks in which an AI carries out multiple steps on its own, the company explained in an announcement.
The idea behind the model’s release is that using the most powerful model isn’t always needed — sometimes a faster, cheaper, and reasonably smart one will do. Google says Hydrogen completes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash, its previous fast model, but it’s still pretty smart, even beating the more powerful Gemini 4 Argon on one broad intelligence benchmark, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , at its default high thinking level.
In Search, Hydrogen brings several improvements, including a better understanding of user intent, the ability to offer more helpful links and visual responses, and better answers across the different languages supported by Google’s AI Mode.
In terms of intent, Google says Hydrogen can handle more nuanced and complicated questions more quickly. This means people can ask their questions in their natural train of thought, including those that have multiple parts or that include highly specific requests. Hydrogen is also better at navigating hard-to-understand typos, Google says. Because of its improvements and better ability to follow instructions and call the right tools, Hydrogen is able to more precisely address each part of a user’s question.
Its advanced reasoning also improves Search’s fan-out technique, which breaks down a single user’s prompt into multiple subqueries. This allows people to discover websites related to the query that they may have otherwise missed, the blog post explains.
The addition of Hydrogen to Search will also mean more images, structured responses, comparison tables, and custom tools will appear as visual responses to users’ queries in AI Mode.
Google also says Hydrogen can work on its own for everyday work in areas like writing code, running tests, or verifying code changes, or it can be paired with Carbon and Argon in workflows that combine several models.
The model offers four thinking levels: low, medium, high (default), and a new, extra-high tier (“xhigh”), all of which are designed to complete tasks faster with fewer output tokens.
On multi-step tasks like deep research, data analysis, and broad codebase navigation, Hydrogen ranks No. 5 on Agent Arena’s benchmarks, the company pointed out.
In addition to Search, Gemini 4 Hydrogen is coming to all tiers of Google’s AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini App, and the paid AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Google’s Antigravity development platform.
Google says the Hydrogen update is rolling out to all Search users globally.

Microsoft 365 issues have been cutting people off from their email since early Thursday afternoon, and they still aren’t fixed.
Since just before 1PM ET on Thursday, reports have come in from around the world that people can’t access their Outlook email, either through the web or apps. Microsoft quickly acknowledged the issue from its Microsoft 365 Status account , saying that “We’ve determined a portion of infrastructure is experiencing elevated load across multiple regions, which is likely contributing to the connectivity errors.”
There were also some reports of problems with Teams, but not to the same extent, while Microsoft’s official updates said customers may experience issues across its suite of 365 business services. Microsoft comms director Ben Hope said in a statement that “We are aware and investigating reports of users experiencing issues with Microsoft 365 services, primarily issues with Exchange Online. We appreciate our customers’ patience while we work to restore services as soon as possible.”
Several hours later, Microsoft has gone through several variations of update notes regarding the issues and its attempts to fix them, saying it’s had problems rebooting servers and being able to monitor their health. As of about 6PM ET, Microsoft has a note saying it’s managed to get some of the affected servers running:
We’ve begun returning a portion of the affected servers to service, and they’re remaining stable so far. We’ve also shifted traffic and connections to alternative pathways wherever possible and have observed limited recovery in some regions.
We’ve streamlined our recovery process to expedite returning the remaining affected servers to service. To further support recovery, we’re implementing protective traffic management measures in a specific location to reduce load on the affected infrastructure, and we’ll expand these measures to additional locations if we observe positive results. As capacity is restored, users may experience a gradual recovery as their clients reconnect to the service.
There’s still no ETA for full restoration, but we will continue to monitor this ongoing outage.

Streamlined recovery process under way, company says, after nearly 130,000 users worldwide reported access issues
Microsoft says a portion of servers are returning to service, and a streamlined recovery process is under way to end a global outage that has resulted in nearly 130,000 users worldwide reporting issues accessing its 365 suite of software, including Outlook and Teams.
Outage website Down Detector showed a spike in Microsoft 365 problems, with nearly 130,000 reports of issues affecting access to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams as well as enterprise services such as SharePoint and OneDrive. AI assistant Copilot was also affected.
New reports have since fallen from that peak, but many said they couldn’t send and receive emails, or had trouble loading their inboxes altogether.
Posting on X, Microsoft said it was “investigating reports of users experiencing issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods”.
Microsoft later explained that a portion of its infrastructure was “experiencing elevated load” – which it said was “likely contributing to the connectivity errors”. The company determined a number of servers were “unexpectedly unavailable” due to a problem that caused them to fail during automated checks.
At 9pm UTC Thursday, the tech company said it had validated an alternative health check method on a subset of the affected servers, which allowed them to successfully return to service, and that fix was now being applied more broadly.
Microsoft was also preparing an automated process to detect and restart unresponsive servers. It said the review of recent changes has identified configuration updates as a potential cause for the issue, but said it was still being investigated.
At 9.41pm UTC, Microsoft said it was working through restarting and validating the affected servers, and looking to expedite the process.
“In parallel, we’re assessing whether reverting the small number of recent configuration updates we identified could help accelerate recovery.”
But by 10.11pm UTC, Microsoft said it was “continuing to pursue all available pathways to restore service” as the actions taken so far “have not provided the anticipated relief”.
The company said a core process on the affected servers was becoming overwhelmed, causing the servers to stop responding.
At 11.06pm UTC, Microsoft said a “portion of the affected servers” had begun being returned to service and were remaining stable.
“We’ve also shifted traffic and connections to alternative pathways wherever possible and have observed limited recovery in some regions.”
The company said it had streamlined its recovery process to expedite returning the remaining affected servers to service, and Microsoft had implemented protective traffic management to reduce the load to the affected servers.
Customers may experience a gradual recovery as users reconnect to 365 services, Microsoft said.
An earlier service degradation alert on Microsoft’s site said it was “aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact” and said it was “restarting affected servers to return them to service”.
“As a precaution, we’ve paused all deployments and configuration changes while we review recent changes for any correlation to this event.
“We’ve determined that the elevated load isn’t driven by an overall increase in traffic, but by a large number of servers being unexpectedly unavailable, which is shifting load onto the remaining infrastructure.
“We’re investigating what’s causing these servers to become unavailable while we work to safely return them to service.”
Mark Gregory, associate professor in the School of Engineering at RMIT University, said the outage appears to be affecting the network layer in Microsoft’s systems, and was potentially similar to the configuration issue which brought down Optus’s network in 2023 .
He said when some of the servers have configuration issues, it means customers are forced to share a smaller pool of servers to access the cloud services.
“If you lose part of that pool, then all of the users are trying to access the remaining servers, and that overloads them. And then they go down.
“And so you end up with a cascading problem. Then it takes time to find the underlying problem, in this case, a misconfiguration in the network layer.”
Gregory said it showed companies should invest more in testing environments for configuration changes before deployment in the live network, and said businesses reliant on cloud services such as Microsoft 365 should have backup options.
“From a global perspective, there is someone somewhere that’s that’s been badly affected by this and you end up with lost productivity,” he said.
“They’re being left high and trying now … it then becomes important to have an alternative.”
“Many people would keep a Gmail account, if their Microsoft goes down, they use Gmail. If Gmail goes down, they use Microsoft.”
Both OpenAI and Anthropic reported the issue was affecting the Microsoft 365 connector that links ChatGPT and Claude AI to Microsoft services.
Earlier, the company said it had “successfully restored” problems related to Microsoft Teams in North America, although some users continued to report connectivity issues.

Gemini 4 Hydrogen isn’t getting a slow, security-conscious release like Carbon and Argon.
Google is continuing its elemental AI naming scheme with the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen . These names are less descriptive than the Pro/Flash monikers of earlier releases, but Hydrogen’s purpose is clear: It replaces the faster, more economical Flash models most people in Google’s ecosystem use.
With Google’s recent Argon and Carbon releases, the rollout was staged and began with cybersecurity researchers. Even when general availability began, Google restricted access to users paying for its most expensive AI subscription. The limits for Hydrogen are much more relaxed, with access beginning immediately. This model has replaced Gemini 3.8 Flash across the company’s products.
Google claims that Hydrogen represents a major improvement versus the previous Flash model. It runs in one of four thinking levels (low, medium, high, and the new xhigh), and even in high mode, it’s 2.5 times faster than Flash 3.8. Plus, it reduces “fabricated claims” by more than 5x, according to Google’s analysis. Users will also see gains in code generation, with Hydrogen more than tripling 3.8 Flash’s score in Terminal-Bench. In some cases, Hydrogen even trades blows with Argon. It managed a score of 54 in the popular Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with xhigh mode versus 50 for Argon.
Google believes Hydrogen will be a key part of how developers work with agentic coding tools. While it still positions Argon and Carbon as the best for long-horizon tasks and security, Hydrogen’s speed makes it ideal for generating simpler code and running tests without blowing through token budgets.
Hydrogen is also being integrated with Google Search , which the company says is the biggest update to its AI-powered search tools ever. The new model should better handle long, multipart questions, and the responses in both AI Overviews and AI Mode will have more visual elements. The company also claims Hydrogen’s fan-out search has been tuned to link to more sources, but we’ve heard that from Google before.
Everyone will reportedly get access to Hydrogen in search, but it’s a bit more restricted in the Gemini app and AI Studio. The new model is live for AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, but AI Plus and free users are still stuck with the old 3.5 Flash-Lite model. Developers can plug into Hydrogen via the API at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, which is unchanged from 3.8 Flash. Carbon and Argon are currently $2/$10, but they will go up to $4/$20 starting next month.

Today, we’re rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen inside Google Antigravity alongside a new model dropdown option called Orchestrator, which pairs Hydrogen with our strongest models for long-horizon tasks, including Gemini 4 Carbon, in an optimized balance of quality, efficiency, and latency.
Selecting Orchestrator (Carbon) from the model selector in Google Antigravity.
Earlier this week, we introduced Gemini 4 Carbon alongside /swarm for tackling massive, multi-worktree engineering tasks with parallel agent teams. In just a couple of days, tens of thousands of swarms have been launched on Antigravity, pushing frontier intelligence on the hardest problems.
For everyday feature work and debugging inside a single session, running a frontier reasoning model with multiple parallel agents on every step of every routine task slows down your loop and burns frontier quota. A common industry approach is to use a static “model router” that guesses task difficulty from your first prompt and routes the entire task to the cheapest model that is good enough to complete the task. Unfortunately, these start breaking down as agents become longer running, requiring different levels of complexity at different stages, often discovered as the task evolves.
Orchestrator takes a dynamic, bidirectional approach between Carbon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen within the evolution of a single trajectory. For example, Carbon can start in a read-only phase to explore dependencies, resolve ambiguities, and build a concrete plan with explicit re-planning triggers. Hydrogen could then take over to write edits, update packages, and run tests. If Hydrogen hits friction, it would hand back to Carbon to inspect the state, repair the plan, and resume execution. This allows Orchestrator to reach near-Carbon task success while being faster and more quota-efficient. On Terminal-Bench 4.1, Orchestrator reached near-Carbon task success rates while, on average, consuming 24% less quota and completing 19% faster.
Pairing Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Gemini 4 Carbon with the Antigravity SDK for automated open-source issue triage and code generation.
Using Gemini 4 Hydrogen in Google Antigravity to upgrade dependencies, refactor shared utilities, and generate accessible image alt text.
Gemini 4 Hydrogen brings cutting-edge intelligence for everyday coding and agentic workflows. When you want frontier planning paired with speed without managing model switches, Orchestrator puts both Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen behind one prompt. Starting today, Gemini 4 Hydrogen is rolling out across paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. Orchestrator is rolling out as Orchestrator (Carbon) and Orchestrator (Argon) for Google AI Ultra subscribers, and as Orchestrator (Argon) for paid Google AI Pro subscribers, with additional models and plans supported in the future. Enterprises can access both in Gemini for business .

A new look for the Humble Bundle storefront is missing an important security feature that was previously there.
The Humble Bundle storefront for buying games and other software recently got a new look, but on the settings page, it no longer offers a way to add or update two-factor verification methods, as reported by Kotaku . PC Gamer also points out that there are Humble Bundle support pages discussing two-factor verification , and the writer for the publication said that they had set up two-factor verification on the old version of the site.
However, it does appear that, at least as of now, there is some form of two-factor verification. When I tried logging into my Humble Bundle account while writing this article, I was prompted to check my email for an access code before I could access my account. While logged in, I was able to update my password, but I didn’t have to enter my old password to be able to do so.
For what it’s worth, my passwords app also shows that I set up a rotating two-factor code for Humble Bundle at some point. I was not asked to input that at any part of my login process today.
Humble Bundle owner IGN Entertainment and IGN parent company Ziff Davis didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment.

Microsoft’s adding achievements to original Xbox games for the first time, too.
For the 25th anniversary of Xbox , Microsoft is beginning to make good on its paid “next-gen game preservation” promise. Starting today, you can play 25 different original Xbox games on your Windows PC, as long as you have (or are willing to pay) for digital copies.
In July, Microsoft originally launched the idea with just four Xbox games , so 25 is progress, and Microsoft says all these games are now playable with keyboard and mouse.
Plus, Microsoft says it’s adding achievements to original Xbox games for the first time, starting with four games: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic and its sequel, Blinx: The Time Sweeper , and Conker: Live and Reloaded . You can unlock achievements playing them on Xbox One and Xbox Series consoles as well, after a system update. More games should get them in future.
Here’s the full list of Xbox on PC games, with the 21 new additions in bold:
Yes, that’s a lot of Star Wars games, most of which already have a PC version, and few games that were exclusive to Xbox at the time. (But many of those Star Wars games were excellent.)
You also won’t be able to use an original Xbox disc to play these games, I’m afraid, as original Xbox (and Xbox 360) discs aren’t part of Microsoft’s disc-to-digital program; they predate the unique serial number that Microsoft embedded into Xbox One discs. In case you’re wondering, Xbox on PC backward compatibility appears to be powered by an emulator .
Also, most of the new games aren’t currently included with Xbox Game Pass, according to Microsoft; just Blinx, Conker, Crimson Skies, Fusion Frenzy, Morrowind, and Grabbed by the Ghoulies .
Leaked Microsoft documents previously showed us that October 2026 would be the “full launch” of original Xbox games on PC, while Xbox 360 games would have a “gradual” rollout to next-gen consoles between 2027 and 2028, which are when Microsoft is expected to roll out a handheld and a Helix box respectively . The way things are shaping up, the Xbox Helix should play games from every generation of Xbox , even if Helix fundamentally turns out to be a Windows PC.

Microsoft is starting to test new customization options for Xbox consoles today. Xbox Insiders will be able to start testing new rotating backgrounds, new library options for digital games, and the ability to move the Xbox Guide menu to the right-hand side.
“Xbox Insiders can now save favorite dynamic backgrounds and shuffle through them automatically,” says Eden Marie , principal software engineering lead at Xbox. “You can also choose Shuffle at the start of any background category. Have your background change each time you sign in, or set it to change hourly, daily, or weekly.”
Microsoft is also improving how you organize disc-to-digital games on an Xbox console. Xbox Insiders who have claimed a digital license from a disc-based game will be able to see these titles in a separate category in the library section. You’ll also be able to hide the digital license icon on game tiles.
Finally, Xbox Insiders will be able to choose whether the Guide menu appears on the left or right side of a screen. “Alpha Skip-Ahead members can try them first,” says Marie. “We’ll bring them to more Xbox Insiders and players over time.”
